notes.title: Ojiv is out of Early Access! Enjoy the full release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512195/e7b8e22acedc3f4df199734879d9b98c2aeea81f.png

3 New Songs

 Alternating Current
 Midnight Echo
 Bottle Cap


3 New Girls

 Echo
 Egatlov
 Tessa


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512195/b029439d4441df13e4663e67df44838c042ffc20.png

New Difficulty Level

Every song now has a new difficulty level called Ultra Fast.
By completing this difficulty, you can earn all girl fragments of the song without completing other difficulties.

Steam Inventory Items
You can now collect every girl as a Steam inventory item. Play the game to earn them as drops or visit the item store to purchase them. The collectable items are listed below.


 Emerald
 Ozgesu
 Ecemsu
 Voltage
 Echo
 Egatlov
 Kaida
 Tessa
 Freja
 Smyrna
 Vortex


Accessibility

 You can now toggle the in game moving background. We've received some feedback about the moving backgrounds making the game way too difficult for some people and decided to add a toggle for them. You can find it in the settings.
 Visibility of notes is increased.


New achievements
With the addition of 8 new achievements, there are a total of 24 achievements you can earn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43512195/382e2630f957e8300cc9fad0f6b26d3aae772187.png

Bug fixes
Implemented numerous bug fixes. Please let us know in the Steam Discussions forum if you encounter any other bugs.

notes.title: Ojiv is out on Early Access! Get it now for 20% off!
notes.content:
Ojiv is out right now on Early Access and you can get it for 20% off with the launch discount!

The launch discount will last until January 24th, so make sure to grab a copy before then!


We need your feedback!

We expect Ojiv to be in Early Access for about 1-2 months. During this time, we are planning to add new songs, fix bugs and make changes according to your feedback. Please feel free to use the Discussions page to give us your feedback or report bugs.

notes.title: 🌺 Anime Girls 🌺
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2205600/Ojiv/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

We are excited to write down our first blog. We have been working on our game for a while and it will be
available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 19 June 2023.

You’ll also be able to join the developer stream on June 19th, 2023. We are humbled by your continuous support from day one.

Ojiv is a fast paced immersive rhytm game.

 Groove along great beats while ripping apart clothings of anime girls.
 Wide selection of handmade levels.
 Different difficulty levels for everyone with every skill level to be able to enjoy this experience.
 Variety of music genres.
 Sexy villans for each music.


That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. We can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to jump in if you would like to reach us directly.

Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
